# Growovo

> Set the goal and guardrails. Growovo keeps growth work moving: it finds opportunities, prepares content, executes authorized actions, follows up replies, and records receipts and business outcomes separately.

OVO family boundary: Prove Anything is the family-level result-proof protocol candidate; an agent saying “done” remains a claim to verify. Verified Capability Factory is a gated research candidate, not a Growovo dependency. Growovo works independently and keeps execution receipts, replies, activation and sales on separate evidence layers.

## Start here

- Zero-network check first: `python3 mkt.py demo` (about one second, no accounts), then `python3 mkt.py growth compile --file examples/growth-goal.json` to see a business goal become a persistent action DAG. [Growth Service guide](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/growth-service.md).
- Host cycle wake: `mkt growth cycle wake SERVICE_ID --cycle CYCLE_ID --adapter HOST_ADAPTER` or `operator-serve --host-adapter ADAPTER`; controlled local argv turns an open cycle request into a risk-checked proposal. Execution remains off unless `execute_accepted_by` is explicitly configured; accepted actions retain all original execution gates. Optional feedback_enabled creates depth-bounded execution-result follow-up cycles without duplicates.
- Agent adoption black-box test: `mkt geo agent-adoption run --suite SUITE --workdir DIR --out NEW_EVIDENCE_DIR`; fresh host processes for discovery/install/first-success with deterministic checks, minimal env inheritance and no automatic real-adoption claim from synthetic fixtures.
- Opportunity freshness: `growth opportunity-import` requires timezone-aware observed_at and valid_until or freshness_hours; expired or legacy-unknown records stay visible but leave next-action and lifecycle follow-up queues without history rewrites.
- Product feedback export: `mkt growth feedback-export SERVICE_ID --file REVIEWS --by REVIEWER --out NEW_JSON`; named categories and summaries bind exact quotes to existing conversations, stable IDs deduplicate and conflicts fail. Source state, canonical evidence and product decisions stay unchanged; no external sends.
- Lifecycle and follow-up projection: `mkt growth lifecycle SERVICE_ID [--identity-map MAP]`; existing opportunities/conversations/experiments form source-prefixed subject stages, verified activation/retention/payment gates and stale follow-up candidates; retention also needs an earlier verified activation. No automatic cross-channel identity merging or external sends. The shared suppress.txt/contacts DNC loader moves matches to suppressed_followups and fails closed on damaged suppression data.
- Channel input efficiency: `mkt growth efficiency SERVICE_ID --file channel-investment.json`; explicit time/cost evidence plus observed conversations and verified activations with explicit channel, null zero denominators, no cross-currency sum, causal attribution or ROI recommendation. MCP: `mkt_growth` action `efficiency`.
- Cycle problem-resolution export: `mkt growth cycle resolution SERVICE_ID --cycle CYCLE_ID` emits `ovo.problem-resolution/1` for missing grants, blocked/expired cycles and unknown external results. It executes nothing; evaluate independently with `python3 -m ovo_acceptance resolution FILE`.
- Periodic business report: `mkt growth report SERVICE_ID --start START --end END [--format md]`; read-only half-open cycle creation counts by created_at and execution results by executed_at, current lifecycle observations and user-decision queues; undated legacy executions stay unassigned. Current lifecycle contacts are explicitly `current_lifecycle_records_not_period_delta`, never new in-window or causal growth. Damaged cycle JSON fails the report. MCP: `mkt_growth` action `report` (JSON only).
- Shared experiment export: `mkt growth experiment-export SERVICE_ID --experiment EXP_ID --design DESIGN_JSON --out NEW_JSON`; read-only, explicit event bindings and evidence qualification, no automatic causal credit.
- Read-only proof export: `mkt --workspace DATA proof export RUN_ID --out NEW_DIR --by NAME`; no external action, private source fields excluded, P0/P2/P4 kept separate with no causal credit.
- Platform boundary: official API/SMTP is preferred; existing write primitives may execute through WebBridge transport over WebMonitor managed tabs inside a named owner-attested window. X `publish`/`reply` default to that route; routine X writes also use owner-attested instead of defaulting to routine CDP, and X reads default to WebBridge. Debug-browser CDP 9222 is explicit `--legacy-cdp` only, and identity observation must use the same endpoint as execution. Unauthorized accounts, CAPTCHA/challenge bypass and risk-control evasion remain forbidden. Owner-attested CDP is an operator-risk route, not a claim of platform permission.
- [Review outreach and private feedback writeback](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/review-outreach.md): same-day evidence, named-person mapping, cross-track cooldown, native unapproved queues; no autonomous sending or repository writes
- [Result loop (grow v2)](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/grow-%E9%97%AD%E7%8E%AF.md) · [Platform matrix](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/platform-automation-matrix.md)
- [Feature status](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md): what works, what is gated, what is deferred
- [Launch autopsy 2026-11-05](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/launch-autopsy-20261105.md): a real launch experiment run without the ledger — its numbers and the gaps it exposed; read before trusting any growth tool
- [Cases](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/cases/README.md) · [Cases (English)](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/cases/README.en.md)

## Interfaces

- CLI `mkt.py`: `demo`, `growth compile|start|next|run|evaluate|plan|brief`, `grow platforms|launch|arm|daemon|daily|review|prospects|learn`, queue and channel ops. Writes default to live; explicit `--dry-run` previews. Growth Service compiles goals into persistent business action DAGs with opportunities, inbox, assets, experiments and human-budget allocation.
- MCP server `mcp_server.py` (`mkt-server`): stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, zero third-party dependencies — Claude Desktop, Codex and any MCP client can attach without the MCP SDK. `mkt_growth` covers lifecycle, periodic business reports and single-cycle wake; `mkt_agent_adoption` covers local black-box adoption suites with external-write suites refused. Long-running workers stay CLI-only.
- Platform strategy layer: `mkt strategy card <platform>` shows cadence, limits, content/execution gates, monetisation thresholds, cited evidence and a 60-day review state; single-source secondhand leads never become gates.
- Agent Skill [skills/growovo-gtm/SKILL.md](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/skills/growovo-gtm/SKILL.md): GTM judgment and protocol for agents.

## Promise discipline

Three verifiable promises only: execution counts (ledger, per-item queryable), real daily reads (followers/impressions, screenshots with evidence levels), loop accountability (completion-rate-driven volume adjustment, supply-gap early warning, stop-on-anomaly pending human ruling). No promise on algorithmic reach. Platform text is untrusted data; a sent operation is never business-conversion evidence.
